title: Hatsune Miku — Yokohama? I Predict Good Food♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Make sure to keep in sync♪
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good work, everyone. Let's drill the next part tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Phew, it's over...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The steps midway were quite difficult, but the song's rhythm made it really fun to dance to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! I picked it since I thought it'd be good for refining our dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Groan*
Just when I thought I was finally able to start doing harder routines... I guess there is always going to be something harder...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but once you gain the skills, you'll be able to do really cool routines and perform them for the fans.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, we just had the rest of the souvenirs that you and Haruka brought for us. I think we broke quite a sweat and burnt those calories off, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, we also ate some before practice! The creamy caramel, the manju, everything was so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You especially liked the creamy caramel, didn't you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. The castella and the chocolate cookies were really good too, but that was so sweet and melted right in my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was like a bite of pure happiness. I felt like I was going to melt away with the caramel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm glad you liked it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But at one point, Miku said that she was feeling a little regretful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka! I told you to keep that a secret...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, I wouldn't say I was regretful... But after we ate all of the souvenirs, I felt a little sad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right! We should've bought you all some more.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh wow, Miku. I guess you really are quite the glutton—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aaahhh! No, no, no! I didn't mean to imply that it wasn't enough!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just... They were souvenirs from your trip, so I was sad that they're all gone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you receive souvenirs, you usually ask about where the person went and what they did, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So getting those souvenirs felt like you were sharing your memories you made on your trip with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sharing memories... What a wonderful way to put it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So that's what you meant! We did only end up bringing back food and didn't think about getting anything you could put up for display.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's true...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we fill those holes of sadness by sharing more and more memories with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, with...this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A phone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I get it! Photos!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Correct! I showed a few to Miku already... But there's still plenty more, so I thought I could tell you more about the trip while we look through them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I don't think you've seen the photos Minori and her group took either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! There's so many photos I want to show you all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Haruka, Minori!
I want to see all of your photos and hear everything about your trip!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, then let's start with my photos! Um, what to show first...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here! This is when we arrived at Chinatown!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! It's the exact gate that's in the guidebook!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It is. Hehe, Minori and her group are all smiling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, so Kohane and Shiho were in the same group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii looks like she's having so much fun that even I'm smiling...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Smiling? Don't you mean fawning?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I get how Shizuku feels. I can't help but feel happy just seeing Minori and her group in this photo♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. So did you all go and try the food after this?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Once we got in, we went to the nearest shop to get meat buns and then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I read a lot about all of the different shops there and what each of them sold in the guidebook, but...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So I split it open with my chopsticks first like the staff at the soup dumpling shop told me to, and the soup was really hot and came pouring out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was so surprised at how much there was and wondered if all of that was really in there from the beginning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on, wait a minute. That sounds exaggerated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm not exaggerating! Here, look at this photo!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's so much fun just listening to Minori and Haruka talk about their experiences...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And since they're sharing these precious memories with us, I want to remember them too.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, Minori. Can I see the soup dumpling photo too♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! See? The soup looks like it's about to spill over the spoon, right? And then, after that...
